name: Unease Makes Tongues Wag: each tiki mask smashes once, credits its objective and summons nothing (#8584, #8781, #8945)
contract: Unease Makes Tongues Wag 1660037 asks for one Enchanted, one Chattering and one Possessed Tiki Mask destroyed (credit creatures 161854, 161855, 161856). The masks are goobers 2300535, 2300536 and 2300537 (spawns 7917000-7917002 at Zeb'Goro).
Using a mask casts Destroying 256719 on it through go_coa_tiki_mask; its SmartAI credits the matching objective on spell hit and despawns the mask one second later, with a 15 s respawn.
Per the maintainer decision in #8189, PR #8280 and #11056, no Tiki Mask enemy spawns: no 161854-161856 creature stands near a used mask. A mask whose objective is done can no longer be smashed.

Expected: each of the three masks credits its own objective once, disappears, and leaves no creature behind. The quest is complete. After a respawn, a used mask stays in place and no further credit is given.
